facts.summary: Phase 2/3 missed primary endpoint, only subgroup signal · Phase 2/3 · SLS-005 in ALS · not yet approved

evidence.summary: While the study did not meet statistical significance in the primary and secondary endpoint in the Full Analysis Set (FAS)2, by showing a 13% improvement in Function and Mortality with an 88% success probability
evidence.primary_endpoint_met: While the study did not meet statistical significance in the primary and secondary endpoint in the Full Analysis Set (FAS)2
evidence.safety: SLS-005 was generally well-tolerated and comparable to placebo in safety. There was an imbalance of deaths/death equivalents observed in the study, with more events seen in the SLS-005 group compared to placebo
evidence.program_discontinued: We plan to request a meeting with the FDA to discuss potential next steps for the program and will continue our potential partner discussions.
